Lunch

Buffalo Chicken Crunchwraps

Buffalo-ranch chicken, cool romaine, blue cheese and crunchy protein chips folded into a crisp, cheesy wrap. A fun two-serving lunch with serious protein.

Prep
Not listed
Cook
Not listed
Total
20 min
Difficulty
Not listed
Ingredients
10

Ingredients

  • 225 g (8 oz) cooked chicken breast, shredded
  • 2 tbsp (20 g) whipped cream cheese
  • ¼ cup (60 ml) Buffalo hot sauce
  • 1 tsp ranch seasoning powder
  • ½ tsp each salt, black pepper and garlic powder
  • 2 large flour tortillas
  • ½ cup shredded romaine lettuce
  • 2 tbsp blue cheese crumbles
  • 1 bag ranch-flavored protein chips, lightly crushed
  • ½ cup (55 g) fat-free cheddar, shredded

Amounts are scaled from 2 original servings. Season to taste.

Instructions

  1. Stir whipped cream cheese, Buffalo sauce, ranch powder, salt, pepper and garlic powder together until smooth.
  2. Fold the shredded chicken into the Buffalo-ranch mixture until well coated.
  3. Lay a tortilla flat. Add half the chicken in the center, then layer on romaine, blue cheese, crushed protein chips and cheddar.
  4. Fold the tortilla edges inward over the filling, working around the circle to make a snug, pleated wrap. Repeat with the second tortilla.
  5. Set each wrap seam-side down in a dry nonstick skillet over medium heat. Press gently and cook 2–3 minutes per side, until golden and crisp and the center is hot.

Cook times may vary when changing batch size.
